sentences.en: In the morning, the whole town knew about the crime.

sentences.ar: جو حكى قدام الناس إن ماف هو القاتل.
sentences.en: Joe told the people that Muff was the killer.
He said: maybe I did it while I was drunk.

sentences.ar: توم وهَك صاروا يجيبوا له أكل عالشباك.
sentences.en: Tom and Huck began bringing him food at the window.

sentences.ar: ماف كان يشكرهم وهو ما بيعرف ليش.
sentences.en: Muff would thank them without knowing why.
And that was harder than the silence.
